invariants.rationale: Method delegates return value from handleUpsertPartition, which should return a non-null iterator.
Partition ID should be assigned and not null for insert partition operations.
A commit action must have a valid instant time. This is required by Hudi's operation semantics.
A partitioner object is required to carry out partitioning which precedes any insertion logic.
The record iterator for incoming records to insert is mandatory and should not be null.
